report.explanation: Alert shows three fast checkout responses (62-78ms) and one 344ms outlier, all HTTP 200. Traces show a single slow request dominated by the order call (~322ms) with healthy downstream spans; metrics show 0 502s and no dependency errors. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (no 5xx, no pool exhaustion, no redis timeout, no memory leak, no deployment). Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handing off for baseline and downstream latency data.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to determine whether 344ms is anomalous versus normal variance
Downstream service (order, payment, inventory) latency metrics to attribute the slow checkout span
Error/timeout logs or 5xx metrics for the checkout path during the incident window
